assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The diagnosis code for atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery is I25.10
The CPT code for the service is 93229
The service is intended to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances
The service is provided in an outpatient setting
The diagnostic monitoring is medically necessary to evaluate the recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness
